# Content Plan Template

**Format:** Markdown Report
**Frequency:** Monthly
**Purpose:** Strategic content calendar with SEO-driven topic selection
**Generated By:** SEO-Planning Workflow / Rocket Growth Strategist Agent

---

## Report Header

```markdown
# Content Plan – {Month} {Year}

**Erstellt am:** {date}
**Erstellt von:** {user_name}
**Planungshorizont:** {month} {year}
**Content-Ziel:** {monthly_article_goal} Artikel
**Newsletter-Frequenz:** {newsletter_frequency}

---
```

---

**Structure:**

```markdown

- 🏛️ Pillar Content: {count} Artikel
- 🎯 Cluster Content: {count} Artikel
- 📰 Newsletter-First: {count} Artikel
- 🔄 Content Updates: {count} Updates

**SEO-Opportunities:**

- **Quick Wins:** {count} Keywords Positionen 11-20
- **New Topics:** {count} neue Topic Cluster

- Interview-Zeit: {total_interview_hours} Stunden

```

## Keyword Research Summary

**Purpose:** Detailed SEO opportunity analysis

**Structure:**

```markdown
## 🔍 Keyword Research & SEO Opportunities

### Quick Win Keywords (Position 11-20)

Diese Keywords ranken bereits auf Seite 2 - mit Optimierung können wir in Top 10 kommen:

| Keyword   | Current Pos. | Search Vol. | Difficulty | Existing URL     | Action             |
| --------- | ------------ | ----------- | ---------- | ---------------- | ------------------ |
| {keyword} | {pos}        | {vol}/mo    | {diff}/100 | [{title}]({url}) | Update & Optimize  |
| {keyword} | {pos}        | {vol}/mo    | {diff}/100 | [{title}]({url}) | Add Internal Links |
| {keyword} | {pos}        | {vol}/mo    | {diff}/100 | [{title}]({url}) | Expand Content     |

**Geschätzte Quick-Win-Value:** {estimated_traffic_gain} zusätzliche Besucher/mo

---

### New Topic Opportunities

Neue Keywords mit guter Opportunity (niedriger Competition, relevantes Volume):

| Keyword   | Search Vol. | Difficulty | Intent                         | Cluster        | Priority |
| --------- | ----------- | ---------- | ------------------------------ | -------------- | -------- |
| {keyword} | {vol}/mo    | {diff}/100 | {informational\|transactional} | {cluster_name} | High     |
| {keyword} | {vol}/mo    | {diff}/100 | {informational\|transactional} | {cluster_name} | Medium   |

---

### Seasonal Keywords

Diese Keywords haben saisonale Peaks - optimal für diesen Monat:

| Keyword   | Search Vol. | Peak Month | Content Idea |
| --------- | ----------- | ---------- | ------------ |
| {keyword} | {vol}/mo    | {month}    | {idea}       |

---

### Competitor Gap Analysis

Keywords für die Competitors ranken, wir aber (noch) nicht:

| Keyword   | Competitor          | Their Position | Our Gap     | Topic Idea |
| --------- | ------------------- | -------------- | ----------- | ---------- |
| {keyword} | {competitor_domain} | {pos}          | Not ranking | {idea}     |

---
```

## Content Updates & Maintenance

**Purpose:** Track necessary updates to existing content

**Structure:**

```markdown
## 🔄 Content Updates & Maintenance

### Scheduled Updates

| Article          | Last Updated | Reason                    | Update Type                | Priority |
| ---------------- | ------------ | ------------------------- | -------------------------- | -------- |
| [{title}]({url}) | {date}       | Traffic drop -40%         | Content refresh + new data | High     |
| [{title}]({url}) | {date}       | Ranking drop (Pos 5 → 15) | SEO optimization           | High     |
| [{title}]({url}) | {date}       | Outdated information      | Fact update                | Medium   |
| [{title}]({url}) | {date}       | Missing cluster links     | Internal linking           | Low      |

---

### Recommended Content Pruning

Artikel die wenig Traffic generieren und nicht zum Cluster-System passen:

| Article          | Traffic (12mo) | Position    | Recommendation               |
| ---------------- | -------------- | ----------- | ---------------------------- |
| [{title}]({url}) | {pageviews}    | Not ranking | 301 Redirect to {target_url} |
| [{title}]({url}) | {pageviews}    | #{pos}      | Merge into {target_article}  |
| [{title}]({url}) | {pageviews}    | #{pos}      | Delete (no SEO value)        |

---

### Content Consolidation Opportunities

Mehrere thin-content Artikel können zu einem umfassenden Artikel konsolidiert werden:

**Consolidation #1:**

- Merge: [{article_1}] + [{article_2}] + [{article_3}]
- Into: New comprehensive article "{new_title}"
- Target Keyword: "{keyword}"
- Setup 301 redirects from old URLs

---
```

## Template Variables

```yaml
{ month }: Current month name
{ year }: Current year
{ date }: Report generation date
{ user_name }: From config
{ monthly_article_goal }: From config
{ newsletter_frequency }: From config
{ pillar_name }: From topic map
{ article_title }: Generated from keyword research
{ keyword }: Target keyword
{ search_volume }: Monthly search volume

{ interview_date }: Scheduled interview date
{ publish_date }: Planned publication date
```

---

## Generation Instructions

**For SEO-Planning Workflow / Rocket Growth Strategist Agent:**

1. **Load Required Data:**
   - topic-map-master.yaml (pillar/cluster structure)
   - GSC data (last 90 days)
   - Google Analytics data (performance metrics)
   - Published articles index
   - Config settings (article goals, frequency)

2. **Analyze SEO Opportunities:**
   - Identify quick wins (position 11-20)
   - Find new keyword opportunities
   - Check seasonal trends
   - Analyze competitor gaps

3. **Plan Content Calendar:**
   - Balance pillar vs cluster content
   - Distribute across weeks
   - Consider interview capacity
   - Align with business priorities

4. **Generate Report:**
   - Fill all template sections
   - Provide specific, actionable recommendations
   - Include data and rationale
   - Make it scannable and actionable

5. **Output:**
   - Save to: {output_folder}/content-plan-{month}-{year}.md
   - Present to user for review and approval
   - Adjust based on feedback
   - Lock in final plan

---

## Usage Notes

- Generate at the beginning of each month
- Review and adjust mid-month if needed
- Archive completed plans for reference
- Use as basis for performance reporting
- Track actual vs planned performance
